tools.name: open_photo_booth
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a photo booth, selfie booth or "Fotobox" for a party, wedding, birthday, office party or any event, or wants to take fun group photos with effects on a phone, tablet or laptop. Shows a card with example images of all effects where the user picks an effect, a collage layo

tools.name: list_photo_booth_effects
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which effects, filters or frames the online photo booth has (e.g. big head, meme, Halloween, wanted poster). Returns every effect with a short description.

tools.name: collect_guest_photos_info
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their guests to upload their own photos from their phones into one shared event album (e.g. via a QR code at a wedding or party). Returns how QR photo collection works, what to check and practical tips, plus one option by the same developer (Guest Pictures). Do not use w

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_photo_booth · Public sink: collect_guest_photos_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_photo_booth · Public sink: collect_guest_photos_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
